verdict.rationale: Listing models is a fair question for an LLM API, but nothing in the evidence documents a programmatic models-list endpoint. What the pack does show is human-readable docs: a model compare table [gpt-supp-models-compare], a models overview page [gpt-docs-26] and a deprecations page [gpt-supp-deprecations]. The SDK is described only generically as REST access [gpt-gh-1], and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths [gpt-probe-3], so no endpoint is evidenced.
